items.name: angr
items.desc: Platform-agnostic binary analysis framework: symbolic execution, decompilation, control-flow and data-dependency analysis, value-set analysis, program instrumentation; Python 3; BSD-2-Clause.

items.name: Apktool
items.desc: Tool for reverse engineering closed Android apps: decode resources to near-original form and rebuild after modification, debug smali step-by-step; Java; Apache-2.0.

items.name: dnSpyEx
items.desc: Unofficial continuation of dnSpy: debugger and assembly editor for .NET and Unity without source code - edit metadata in C#/VB, breakpoints, tracepoints, hex memory window; C#; GPL-3.0.

items.name: Frida
items.desc: Dynamic instrumentation toolkit for reverse engineers and security researchers: inject code into running iOS/Android/desktop apps; C core, Python/Node bindings; custom license.

items.name: ghidraMCP
items.desc: MCP server plus Ghidra plugin for LLM-driven reverse engineering: decompile and analyze binaries, auto-rename methods and data, list methods/classes/imports/exports; Python + uv; Apache-2.0.

items.name: IDA Pro MCP
items.desc: MCP server for 'vibe reversing' in IDA Pro 8.3+/9: LLM-guided decompile, analyze and inspect via tools exposed to any MCP client; Python 3.11, uv, idalib; MIT.

items.name: ILSpy
items.desc: Open-source cross-platform .NET assembly browser and decompiler: Avalonia desktop UI, VS and VS Code extensions, ILSpyCmd dotnet tool, decompile F12 in Visual Studio; C#; MIT.

items.name: ImHex
items.desc: Hex editor for reverse engineers and programmers: pattern language structures, bookmarks, data inspector, diffing, custom encodings and visualizes with themes; C++ (Qt); GPL-2.0.

items.name: jadx
items.desc: Dex to Java decompiler: command-line and GUI tools producing Java source from APK/dex/aab, plus Java bytecode and smali; deobfuscator, resource decoding, smali debugger; Java 11; Apache-2.0.

items.name: RAD Debugger
items.desc: Native, user-mode, multi-process graphical debugger from Epic Games: local x64 on Windows and early Linux, RDI debug-info format, radbin conversion, alpha; C; MIT.

items.name: radare2
items.desc: Libre reversing framework: disassemble, debug, edit and emulate any binary on any architecture; embedded JS interpreter and r2pipe; pip-style install script; C; LGPL-3.0.

items.name: rizin
items.desc: Reversing framework born as a fork of radare2 focused on usability and cleanliness: analyze binaries, disassemble, debug, forensics, scriptable hex editor; C, meson build; LGPL-3.0.

items.name: x64dbg
items.desc: Open-source Windows user-mode debugger for x86/x64 aimed at malware analysis: CPU tracing graph, memory map, plugin system; C++; freeware.

items.name: APK Reverse
items.desc: Tool for reverse engineering Android apps: APK unpacking, decompilation, code and resource analysis.

items.name: Binwalk
items.desc: A firmware analysis tool: finds embedded file systems, signatures and images inside binaries. A classic of firmware reversing, now in Rust.

items.name: F Society
items.desc: General hacking tools

items.name: Ghidra
items.desc: A legendary reverse engineering framework from the NSA: disassembler + decompiler, analysis of binaries of any architecture, scripts in Java/Python. A standard for RE and malware analysis. Current version 12.1.3.

items.name: Kong RE
items.desc: “Agentic reverse engineer”: LLM orchestration of binary analysis via Ghidra — recovers names/types/structures in obfuscated binaries in minutes instead of days.

items.name: mitmproxy
items.desc: Interactive intercepting HTTPS proxy in Python: TLS cert spoofing, replay, scripting, mitmdump CLI and mitmweb UI, HAR export; TLS-capable debugging of HTTP traffic; MIT.

items.name: REA
items.desc: AI agent for reverse engineering: connects to Hopper/Ghidra via MCP and analyzes apps without source code — native binaries, Electron, .NET, websites. Shows evidence and helps rebuild a feature for your own project.

items.name: StegoForge
items.desc: A steganography and digital forensics toolkit: hiding and extracting data in images, audio, video, documents and network packets + 11 engines for detecting hidden payloads.

items.name: x64dbg MCP Server
items.desc: Native MCP plugin for x64dbg: exposes debugger over HTTP; AI sets breakpoints, steps code, reads memory, dumps registers. Reversing/malware analysis with Claude.

items.name: CamFish
items.desc: phishing for camera shots

items.name: DockDroid
items.desc: Android in Docker: an isolated sandbox for testing

items.name: ZPhisher
items.desc: A set of phishing pages of popular services for testing on people

items.name: Amass (OWASP)
items.desc: Powerful reconnaissance of domains and subdomains: passive sources, DNS brute force, scraping, building a map of external infrastructure.

items.name: BloodHound
items.desc: Graph analysis of an Active Directory domain: collects relationships between users/groups/hosts and finds hidden escalation paths to domain admin. SpecterOps.

items.name: Burp Suite (PortSwigger)
items.desc: Official Burp Suite (PortSwigger): standard web app security toolkit. Free Community for manual testing, Pro with Scanner for pentesters, DAST for automated CI scanning.

items.name: Burp Suite Professional
items.desc: The main proxy for web pentesting: intercepting and replaying requests, vulnerability scanner, Intruder fuzzer, extensions via the BApp Store.

items.name: Decepticon
items.desc: autonomous AI agent for professional red team that goes through the full attack chain on its own

items.name: Deep Eye
items.desc: An AI-based pentest orchestrator: runs 10+ providers (OpenAI, Claude, Grok, Ollama...) to generate payloads, scans 45+ vulnerability types and produces professional reports with compliance mapping.

items.name: dnstwist MCP
items.desc: Typosquat detection, domain permutation checking: free, no key; community.

items.name: ffuf
items.desc: Fast web fuzzer in Go: brute-forcing directories/files/parameters, vhost fuzzing, recursion, filters by size/code/time. Based on gobuster, but more powerful.

items.name: HexStrike AI
items.desc: MCP server letting AI agents operate 150+ cybersecurity tools for authorized pentesting (recon, scanning, exploitation tooling); MIT; 13k stars.

items.name: Masscan
items.desc: The fastest port scanner on the planet: the whole internet in 6 minutes, millions of packets/sec. To find open ports — only this. Account for the limitations of SYN scanning.

items.name: Metasploit
items.desc: The main exploit framework: thousands of exploits and payloads, post-exploitation, meterpreter, automatic exploitation of vulnerabilities.

items.name: NetExec
items.desc: A fork of CrackMapExec — a Swiss army knife for networks: credential checks on SMB/WinRM/LDAP/SSH/MSSQL, login dumping, password spraying. Alive and developing.

items.name: Nikto
items.desc: Classic web server scanner: outdated software, dangerous files, injections, misconfigurations. A quick first pass over a site.

items.name: Nmap
items.desc: Network discovery and port scanning tool with NSE scripts, for authorized testing and inventory; free, GPL.

items.name: Nuclei
items.desc: Template-based vulnerability scanner from ProjectDiscovery: thousands of ready-made templates (CVE, panels, exposure) + your own in YAML. Fast, accurate, CLI.

items.name: OWASP ZAP
items.desc: OWASP open-source web app security scanner and proxy for finding vulnerabilities, for authorized testing; free, Apache-2.0.

items.name: Pentagi
items.desc: Autonomous AI agent system for complex penetration testing tasks; multi-agent pentest workflows; self-hosted via Docker; Go/React; pentagi.com; MIT.

items.name: Pentest Agent
items.desc: AI pentest assistant: plain-language task ("check this server") triggers Nmap, Metasploit, SQLMap etc., outputs report.

items.name: PentestCode
items.desc: Autonomous pentest agent in the terminal: multi-agent attack chain with nmap, SMB/LDAP enumeration, AS-REP roast, spraying, post-exploit, engagement state, 20+ LLM providers; fork of OpenCode; MIT.

items.name: pwn.college
items.desc: a platform for learning pentesting and binary exploitation from ASU: theory + hands-on labs

items.name: reKover
items.desc: Bash URL mapper for recon: robots/sitemap parsing, weighted brute force, JS-aware crawl, Wayback CDX probes; JSON output; needs parallel+curl; MIT.

items.name: ScopeWeaver
items.desc: LLM multi-agent autonomous pentest (ARTEX): planner/worker agents over shared graphs, traffic proxy, tool-approval gate. Go+Next.js+PostgreSQL, needs LLM key. AGPL-3.0; personal study only.

items.name: Shannon
items.desc: Autonomous AI pentester for authorized web/API testing: reads your source code, maps attack paths and runs POC exploits to prove findings; CLI agent; AGPL-3.0.

items.name: Shodan MCP
items.desc: Internet device/IP lookup, banners, CVE intel via Shodan API: server free, real use needs $49 membership; community, moderately active.

items.name: Skipfish
items.desc: website vulnerability scanner

items.name: sqlmap
items.desc: Automatic SQL injection combine: detects the DB type, dumps tables, reads files, gets a shell. The standard in web pentesting.

items.name: Strix
items.desc: autonomous AI agents for pentesting: they run code themselves, look for vulnerabilities (SQLi, XSS, SSRF, IDOR, etc.) and prove them with a real working exploit, not just a warning

items.name: T3MP3ST
items.desc: An autonomous red-team platform from plinius: a multi-agent meta-harness for offensive security; agents plan and carry out attacks on their own.

items.name: VirusTotal MCP
items.desc: URL/hash/domain maliciousness scans via VirusTotal API: freemium with rate-limited free tier; community.

items.name: Vulnerator AI
items.desc: Autonomous agent for authorized penetration testing: OODA-loop reasoning, Kali and Playwright browser tools over MCP, ATT&CK-style orientation; MIT.

items.name: Bandit
items.desc: PyCQA static analyzer finding common security issues in Python code; free, Apache-2.0.

items.name: ClamAV
items.desc: Open-source antivirus engine for mail gateways and file scanning with signature database; free, GPL.

items.name: gitleaks
items.desc: Tool for detecting secrets (passwords, API keys, tokens) in git repos, files and stdin with rules and entropy scanning; git/cron integration; Docker, Homebrew, Go installs; MIT.

items.name: MinerSearch
items.desc: Finding and removing hidden miners on Windows

items.name: opencode-vibeguard
items.desc: OpenCode plugin that auto-redacts secrets/PII before they reach the AI; free, no key; community.

items.name: OSS Scanner
items.desc: Anthropic model-driven vuln scanning for critical OSS: PR adds project.yaml+Dockerfile, built/scanned in VM, findings with reproducers/patches emailed. Not human-reviewed. Apache-2.0.

items.name: OWASP Cheatsheets
items.desc: OWASP Cheat Sheet Series — proven application security checklists: authentication, sessions, SQLi, XSS, cryptography and dozens of other topics.

items.name: PhoneHackScan
items.desc: Android/iPhone spyware check: USB quick scan, androidqf + MVT full scan, iOS backup analysis, optional VirusTotal hashes; Python 3.10+; GPL-3.0.

items.name: PrivacyTools.io
items.desc: Curated privacy app directory: 350+ reviewed tools and services with filters, ratings and alternatives for encryption, VPN, browsers and self-hosting; web directory.

items.name: Trivy
items.desc: Aqua open-source scanner for vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, secrets and SBOM in containers and repos; free, Apache-2.0.

items.name: Veracode
items.desc: Commercial static and dynamic application security testing platform; paid, vendor pricing.

items.name: DDOS Ripper
items.desc: Server stress-testing tool

items.name: Hping
items.desc: Console TCP/UDP packet generator for testing networks

items.name: Hashcat
items.desc: brute-forcing passwords of zips, folders, etc. via hash files

items.name: Hydra (THC)
items.desc: Network login brute-forcer over protocols: SSH, FTP, HTTP forms, RDP, SMB, MySQL and dozens of others. Parallel, fast, a pentest standard.

items.name: John the Ripper
items.desc: Classic hash brute-forcer: hundreds of Unix/Windows/DB/archive formats, wordlist/rules/GPU modes. Jumbo build.
